newsitem.title: USA: Diana sees Sattel Q4 revs lower than Q3.
newsitem.headline: Diana sees Sattel Q4 revs lower than Q3.

text.p: Diana Corp said Monday that it is projecting revenues from Sattel Communications to be about $1 million for the fourth quarter ended March 31, 1997, compared with $4.3 million reported for the quarter ended December 31, 1996.

"While revenues for the fourth quarter were obviously below our expectations, we expect to see significant sales order improvement in the current quarter," said James Fiedler, chairman and chief executive officer in a press release.

The company also said that it is negotiating additional financing plans, including the sale of subsidiaries and assets, obtaining additional equity, and pursuing other sources of capital to bolster financial strength..
Diana said it recently signed a definitive agreement for the sale of Valley Communications to a private investment group for about $4 million.
The sale is conditional on a final audit and is expected to close in May.
In addition, the company has negotiated a short-term $1.5 million loan with another private investment group, it said.
In the fourth quarter, Sattel reduced its accounts receivables by 10 percent, while increasing its inventories by only five percent, the company said.
In the fourth quarter, Sattel collected $1.8 million in receivables.
